facts.fact: Agence Ecofin reports the national AI roadmap 2026-2030, validated but not yet officially published, is endowed with a budget of FCFA 30 billion (USD 51.1 million), presented by the digital transition ministry on 2026-10-23.

facts.fact: Agence Ecofin says a workshop at Koudougou on 24-28 March 2026, run by the digital ministry with RTB and CITADEL, worked on language formalisation and corpus building in Moore, Dioula, Fulfulde and Gulmancema for speech recognition, machine translation and speech synthesis tools.
